title: Majority Element
statement_short: Given an array of size n, find the element that appears more than floor(n / 2) times. You may assume that the majority element always exists in the input array.
hint: Input size up to 5 * 10^4 requires O(n) time, and the guaranteed majority property enables O(1) space element cancellation.
why_not: Right: Boyer-Moore Voting pairs majority and minority items to cancel non-majority elements in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Sorting: Sorting puts the majority element at index n/2 but costs O(n log n) time. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Frequency counting takes O(n) time but requires O(n) extra space. Not Bit Manipulation: Bitwise counting takes O(32n) time, which is slower than linear voting.
